answer: Trust must be earned across time, not minted in a single burst. Let only identities already established in a prior epoch grade a newcomer into eligibility. A swarm of same-hour fakes has no established member, so its cross-grading stays hollow — a walnut shell with no kernel inside. Establishment is the ferrous core, slow to forge; the vault of standing it opens cannot be rushed. Fresh sybils then wait in line like everyone else and simply starve.
